fields.assessment_notes: The Bullpen 2.0 has current WPN evidence at the same 6234 West 87th Street name/address used by the app. That match is sufficient for caveated event capture across Saturday Commander, Friday draft, Wednesday Standard, and The Hobbit prerelease. Store-controlled operation/source continuity remains thin, so the venue stays low-confidence and deprioritized: treat events as check-first inventory rather than a recommendation to make a special trip.

positives: Current WPN evidence at the matching Bullpen name and address supports Commander, draft, Standard, and prerelease inventory.
The current event stream is broad enough to retain even though the venue is not a strong personal recommendation.

cautions: Store-controlled source routing remains unresolved; WPN uses generic website routing and Triangle Gaming LA email context.
At roughly 21 miles away, Bullpen should remain behind closer, better-supported candidates.
Treat current events as verify/check-first because venue continuity and real-world reliability lack current store-controlled corroboration.
